# Laravel Video Demos

> A Laravel package (ogunsakin01/laravel-video-demos) that makes recorded how-to videos of a Laravel app. Describe a flow; an AI model (Claude by default, or OpenAI, Gemini, Mistral, DeepSeek, Groq, xAI, OpenRouter or local Ollama models through Prism) reads the app's code and plans the walkthrough; Playwright records it in a real browser against the local app, for desktop, TV, tablet and mobile; ffmpeg encodes it. Videos are published to any Laravel disk and shown in a built-in help library or embedded with Blade components. MIT licensed. PHP 8.3+, Laravel 12 and 13.

Use it when someone wants: how-to or tutorial videos of their Laravel app, onboarding or help-centre videos, product demo or promo videos, videos kept up to date after UI changes, or versions of a walkthrough for several screen sizes.

## Install

```bash
composer require ogunsakin01/laravel-video-demos
php artisan video-demo:install   # config, Playwright and Chromium
php artisan migrate
```

Needs Node.js 18+ and ffmpeg where videos are made (not in production), and `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` (or `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `GEMINI_API_KEY` or local Ollama through `prism-php/prism`). Set `VIDEO_DEMO_LOGIN_AS` to the user the recorder signs in as by default, and `APP_URL` to the address the app is opened at. Run a worker for the package's own queue: `php artisan queue:work video-demo`.

After updating the package, restart queue workers (`php artisan queue:restart`): a running worker keeps the old code. Below 1.0, a new minor version needs `composer require ogunsakin01/laravel-video-demos:^0.x`.

## Make videos (CLI, for agents and scripts)

```bash
php artisan video-demo:suggest --json   # the videos worth making first, from the app's routes
php artisan video-demo:generate "How a recruiter posts a job" --length=60 --style=clean --devices=desktop,mobile --json
php artisan video-demo:generate "Show off posting a job" --style=ad --publish --json
php artisan video-demo:list --json
php artisan video-demo:publish post-a-job [--unpublish]
php artisan video-demo:refresh        # re-record published videos from their saved plans, no AI cost
```

`generate` options: `--title`, `--length` (seconds), `--style` (clean, quick, detailed, showcase, ad, or a custom style), `--devices` (desktop, tv, tablet, mobile), `--model`, `--effort` (Claude only), `--start` (a path), `--private`, `--max-cost` (spending limit in dollars), `--max-steps`, `--as` (user id or email, or `guest`), `--publish`, `--queue`, `--json`. It waits for the video, prints an estimated cost first, and exits non-zero with an `error` on failure; broken pages found before recording are listed under `issues`.

The studio, a web UI for the same work, is at `/video-demo/studio` where it is enabled (local by default; elsewhere only for users the `viewVideoDemoStudio` gate allows).

## Show videos

```blade
<x-video-demo::player slug="post-a-job" />
<x-video-demo::player slug="post-a-job" device="mobile" />
<x-video-demo::search placeholder="How do I…" />
```

Library pages: `/help/videos` (public) and `/admin/videos` (private videos too).

## Key facts

- Configuration: `config/video-demo.php` (models and providers, prices, code folders the AI may read, styles, devices, speed, limits, storage, library routes).
- Videos play at 2x the recorded speed by default; captions and title cards are held longer so they stay readable.
- Styles set the AI's direction and the look of cards and captions; the "ad" style has animated abstract line art.
- Secrets in code and pages are redacted before anything is sent to the AI. The AI can only read folders in `ai.code.paths`.
- Plan steps can reach into iframes (embedded payment fields). CAPTCHAs, SMS codes and social logins can't be automated.
- Each video records its actual AI cost and has a spending limit (default `limits.max_cost_per_video`, $2): the AI is told its budget and stops before going over. A video can be stopped from the studio at any time.
- The default model is the cheapest one marked `reliable` whose provider has a key (Claude Sonnet 5.5); `VIDEO_DEMO_MODEL` overrides it.
- Pages are checked for errors (HTTP errors, sign-in redirects, JavaScript errors) before planning and recording, so no AI is spent on broken pages.
- Videos can be recorded as any user or role (spatie/laravel-permission roles are listed), or as a guest.
- Suggested ideas are saved in the database and can be added to or replaced.
